en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：

en.text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

zhSimplified.text: 「你晓谕以色列人说：耶和华的节期，你们要宣告为圣会的节期。

zhTraditional.text: 「你曉諭以色列人說：耶和華的節期，你們要宣告為聖會的節期。

en.text: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.

zhSimplified.text: 六日要做工，第七日是圣安息日，当有圣会；你们什么工都不可做。这是在你们一切的住处向耶和华守的安息日。

zhTraditional.text: 六日要做工，第七日是聖安息日，當有聖會；你們甚麼工都不可做。這是在你們一切的住處向耶和華守的安息日。

en.text: “‘These are the set feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的节期，就是你们到了日期要宣告为圣会的，乃是这些。」 （民28·16—25）

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的節期，就是你們到了日期要宣告為聖會的，乃是這些。」 （民28‧16－25）

en.text: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is the LORD’s Passover.

zhSimplified.text: 「正月十四日，黄昏的时候，是耶和华的逾越节。

zhTraditional.text: 「正月十四日，黃昏的時候，是耶和華的逾越節。

en.text: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

zhSimplified.text: 这月十五日是向耶和华守的无酵节；你们要吃无酵饼七日。

zhTraditional.text: 這月十五日是向耶和華守的無酵節；你們要吃無酵餅七日。

en.text: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

zhSimplified.text: 第一日当有圣会，什么劳碌的工都不可做；

zhTraditional.text: 第一日當有聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做；

en.text: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”

zhSimplified.text: 要将火祭献给耶和华七日。第七日是圣会，什么劳碌的工都不可做。」

zhTraditional.text: 要將火祭獻給耶和華七日。第七日是聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。」

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：

en.text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.

zhSimplified.text: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我赐给你们的地，收割庄稼的时候，要将初熟的庄稼一捆带给祭司。

zhTraditional.text: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我賜給你們的地，收割莊稼的時候，要將初熟的莊稼一捆帶給祭司。

en.text: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

zhSimplified.text: 他要把这一捆在耶和华面前摇一摇，使你们得蒙悦纳。祭司要在安息日的次日把这捆摇一摇。

zhTraditional.text: 他要把這一捆在耶和華面前搖一搖，使你們得蒙悅納。祭司要在安息日的次日把這捆搖一搖。

en.text: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 摇这捆的日子，你们要把一岁、没有残疾的公绵羊羔献给耶和华为燔祭。

zhTraditional.text: 搖這捆的日子，你們要把一歲、沒有殘疾的公綿羊羔獻給耶和華為燔祭。

en.text: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the LORD for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

footnotes.text: 23:13 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel
23:13 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons.

zhSimplified.text: 同献的素祭，就是调油的细面伊法十分之二，作为馨香的火祭，献给耶和华。同献的奠祭，要酒一欣四分之一。

zhTraditional.text: 同獻的素祭，就是調油的細麵伊法十分之二，作為馨香的火祭，獻給耶和華。同獻的奠祭，要酒一欣四分之一。

en.text: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

zhSimplified.text: 无论是饼，是烘的子粒，是新穗子，你们都不可吃，直等到把你们献给 神的供物带来的那一天才可以吃。这在你们一切的住处作为世世代代永远的定例。」 （民28·26—31）

zhTraditional.text: 無論是餅，是烘的子粒，是新穗子，你們都不可吃，直等到把你們獻給上帝的供物帶來的那一天才可以吃。這在你們一切的住處作為世世代代永遠的定例。」 （民28‧26－31）

en.text: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.

zhSimplified.text: 「你们要从安息日的次日，献禾捆为摇祭的那日算起，要满了七个安息日。

zhTraditional.text: 「你們要從安息日的次日，獻禾捆為搖祭的那日算起，要滿了七個安息日。

en.text: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 到第七个安息日的次日，共计五十天，又要将新素祭献给耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 到第七個安息日的次日，共計五十天，又要將新素祭獻給耶和華。

en.text: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to the LORD.

footnotes.text: 23:17 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel

zhSimplified.text: 要从你们的住处取出细面伊法十分之二，加酵，烤成两个摇祭的饼，当作初熟之物献给耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 要從你們的住處取出細麵伊法十分之二，加酵，烤成兩個搖祭的餅，當作初熟之物獻給耶和華。

en.text: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to the LORD, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 又要将一岁、没有残疾的羊羔七只、公牛犊一只、公绵羊两只，和饼一同奉上。这些与同献的素祭和奠祭要作为燔祭献给耶和华，就是作馨香的火祭献给耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 又要將一歲、沒有殘疾的羊羔七隻、公牛犢一隻、公綿羊兩隻，和餅一同奉上。這些與同獻的素祭和奠祭要作為燔祭獻給耶和華，就是作馨香的火祭獻給耶和華。

en.text: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭，两只一岁的公绵羊羔为平安祭。

zhTraditional.text: 你們要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，兩隻一歲的公綿羊羔為平安祭。

en.text: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司要把这些和初熟麦子做的饼一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这是献与耶和华为圣物归给祭司的。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司要把這些和初熟麥子做的餅一同作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；這是獻與耶和華為聖物歸給祭司的。

en.text: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

zhSimplified.text: 当这日，你们要宣告圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做。这在你们一切的住处作为世世代代永远的定例。

zhTraditional.text: 當這日，你們要宣告聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。這在你們一切的住處作為世世代代永遠的定例。

en.text: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.’”

zhSimplified.text: 「在你们的地收割庄稼，不可割尽田角，也不可拾取所遗落的；要留给穷人和寄居的。我是耶和华—你们的 神。」 （民29·1—6）

zhTraditional.text: 「在你們的地收割莊稼，不可割盡田角，也不可拾取所遺落的；要留給窮人和寄居的。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。」 （民29‧1－6）

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：

en.text: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

zhSimplified.text: 「你晓谕以色列人说：七月初一，你们要守为圣安息日，要吹角作纪念，当有圣会。

zhTraditional.text: 「你曉諭以色列人說：七月初一，你們要守為聖安息日，要吹角作紀念，當有聖會。

en.text: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.’”

zhSimplified.text: 什么劳碌的工都不可做；要将火祭献给耶和华。」 （民29·7—11）

zhTraditional.text: 甚麼勞碌的工都不可做；要將火祭獻給耶和華。」 （民29‧7－11）

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：

en.text: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 「七月初十是赎罪日；你们要守为圣会，并要刻苦己心，也要将火祭献给耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 「七月初十是贖罪日；你們要守為聖會，並要刻苦己心，也要將火祭獻給耶和華。

en.text: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before the LORD your God.

zhSimplified.text: 当这日，什么工都不可做；因为是赎罪日，要在耶和华—你们的 神面前赎罪。

zhTraditional.text: 當這日，甚麼工都不可做；因為是贖罪日，要在耶和華－你們的上帝面前贖罪。

en.text: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.

zhSimplified.text: 当这日，凡不刻苦己心的，必从民中剪除。

zhTraditional.text: 當這日，凡不刻苦己心的，必從民中剪除。

en.text: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.

zhSimplified.text: 凡这日做什么工的，我必将他从民中除灭。

zhTraditional.text: 凡這日做甚麼工的，我必將他從民中除滅。

en.text: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

zhSimplified.text: 你们什么工都不可做。这在你们一切的住处作为世世代代永远的定例。

zhTraditional.text: 你們甚麼工都不可做。這在你們一切的住處作為世世代代永遠的定例。

en.text: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

zhSimplified.text: 你们要守这日为圣安息日，并要刻苦己心。从这月初九日晚上到次日晚上，要守为安息日。」 （民29·12—40）

zhTraditional.text: 你們要守這日為聖安息日，並要刻苦己心。從這月初九日晚上到次日晚上，要守為安息日。」 （民29‧12－40）

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：

en.text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to the LORD.

footnotes.text: 23:34 or, feast of tents, or Succoth

zhSimplified.text: 「你晓谕以色列人说：这七月十五日是住棚节，要在耶和华面前守这节七日。

zhTraditional.text: 「你曉諭以色列人說：這七月十五日是住棚節，要在耶和華面前守這節七日。

en.text: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

zhSimplified.text: 第一日当有圣会，什么劳碌的工都不可做。

zhTraditional.text: 第一日當有聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。

en.text: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.

zhSimplified.text: 七日内要将火祭献给耶和华。第八日当守圣会，要将火祭献给耶和华。这是严肃会，什么劳碌的工都不可做。

zhTraditional.text: 七日內要將火祭獻給耶和華。第八日當守聖會，要將火祭獻給耶和華。這是嚴肅會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。

en.text: “‘These are the appointed feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—

zhSimplified.text: 「这是耶和华的节期，就是你们要宣告为圣会的节期；要将火祭、燔祭、素祭、祭物，并奠祭，各归各日，献给耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 「這是耶和華的節期，就是你們要宣告為聖會的節期；要將火祭、燔祭、素祭、祭物，並奠祭，各歸各日，獻給耶和華。

en.text: in addition to the Sabbaths of the LORD, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 这是在耶和华的安息日以外，又在你们的供物和所许的愿，并甘心献给耶和华的以外。

zhTraditional.text: 這是在耶和華的安息日以外，又在你們的供物和所許的願，並甘心獻給耶和華的以外。

en.text: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of the LORD seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

zhSimplified.text: 「你们收藏了地的出产，就从七月十五日起，要守耶和华的节七日。第一日为圣安息；第八日也为圣安息。

zhTraditional.text: 「你們收藏了地的出產，就從七月十五日起，要守耶和華的節七日。第一日為聖安息；第八日也為聖安息。

en.text: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.

zhSimplified.text: 第一日要拿美好树上的果子和棕树上的枝子，与茂密树的枝条并河旁的柳枝，在耶和华—你们的 神面前欢乐七日。

zhTraditional.text: 第一日要拿美好樹上的果子和棕樹上的枝子，與茂密樹的枝條並河旁的柳枝，在耶和華－你們的上帝面前歡樂七日。

en.text: You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.

zhSimplified.text: 每年七月间，要向耶和华守这节七日。这为你们世世代代永远的定例。

zhTraditional.text: 每年七月間，要向耶和華守這節七日。這為你們世世代代永遠的定例。

en.text: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,

zhSimplified.text: 你们要住在棚里七日；凡以色列家的人都要住在棚里，

zhTraditional.text: 你們要住在棚裏七日；凡以色列家的人都要住在棚裏，

en.text: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’”

zhSimplified.text: 好叫你们世世代代知道，我领以色列人出埃及地的时候曾使他们住在棚里。我是耶和华—你们的 神。」

zhTraditional.text: 好叫你們世世代代知道，我領以色列人出埃及地的時候曾使他們住在棚裏。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。」

en.text: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，摩西将耶和华的节期传给以色列人。

zhTraditional.text: 於是，摩西將耶和華的節期傳給以色列人。
